story.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁车队祝贺其技术合作伙伴本田赛车在即将到来的美国大奖赛上达到500场F1赛事的里程碑。

story.originalTitle: All at Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team send our congratulations to our Technical Partner @HondaRacingF1, as they reach the milestone of 500 Formu...
story.summaryEn:
All at Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team send our congratulations to our Technical Partner @HondaRacingF1, as they reach the milestone of 500 Formula One races at this weekend's #USGP.
Read more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/announcement/aston-martin-aramcos-technical-partner-honda-reaches-milestone-of-500-f1-races
detailZh:
所有阿斯顿·马丁阿拉姆科一级方程式车队成员向我们的技术合作伙伴@HondaRacingF1致以祝贺，因为他们在本周末的美国大奖赛（#USGP）达到了500场一级方程式赛事的里程碑。
了解更多：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/announcement/aston-martin-aramcos-technical-partner-honda-reaches-milestone-of-500-f1-races
